title: Confidence-Weighted Exposure Manager for per-variant A/B experiments and automatic rollback
creator: Anika Shah
description:
Problem: teams need a single orchestration primitive that runs controlled experiments on model versions with adaptive exposure, live statistical checks, and deterministic auto-rollback. Current ad-hoc canaries and shadowing are brittle: they either surface false alarms due to noisy signals or wait too long to revert harmful regressions.

Proposal: Build the Confidence-Weighted Exposure Manager (CWEM) — a service + Console workflow that: 1) schedules per-variant exposure using a confidence-weighted controller that increases or decreases traffic based on posterior metric distributions; 2) supports sequential statistical tests (Bayesian posterior credible intervals, alpha-spending boundaries for frequentist users) for both binary and continuous metrics; 3) integrates shadow traffic and sampling-only cohorts; 4) provides deterministic auto-rollback policies (hard thresholds + growth-smoothing) and manual override hooks; and 5) surfaces experiment health in Redwood Console with actionable signals and recommended next steps.

Key design points: using Bayesian sequential checks as default (Beta-Bernoulli for conversion-like signals, Gaussian/posterior-t for continuous metrics) to allow continuous monitoring without fixed sample-size alpha inflation. The controller exposes a tunable exposure schedule (growth rate, max exposure cap, min dwell time) and a backoff policy that factors in both magnitude of regression and uncertainty. For safety-critical tenants we allow a strict policy mode (immediate fallback to baseline on any >X% degradation with high confidence).

Why different: instead of purely time-based canaries or fixed-sample A/B, CWEM continuously balances statistical confidence with business impact, making rollouts both faster and safer. It also unifies shadow-first verification, staged traffic ramping, and automated rollback into a single experiment object that teams can reuse across models and routes.
acceptance_criteria: Console: create + edit experiment UI with variant definitions, metric selectors, and exposure policy fields
API: create / experiments endpoint that returns experiment status, exposure percentages, and posterior summaries
Controller: implement confidence-weighted exposure algorithm that adjusts per-minute exposure within configured caps
Stats: support Bayesian credible intervals for binary and continuous metrics and an optional frequentist alpha-spend test
Rollback: automatic rollback trigger based on configurable guardrails (e.g., relative metric delta + posterior probability > 95%)
Telemetry: per-variant time-series dashboards and alert rules in Console with links to raw logs and experiment artifacts
Docs: runbook for experiment authors explaining metrics selection, priors, and interpreting posterior outputs
E2E: end-to-end test from experiment creation to automatic rollback using a canary model simulated failure profile
tasks: PM: finalize rollout policy defaults and safety-mode options
Eng-Infra: add experiment metadata store and expose event stream for metric aggregation
Eng-Runtime: wiring to routing layer to accept exposure updates every 60s
Eng-Stats: implement posterior computation microservice and alpha-spend option
Design: mock Console pages for experiment creation, live view, and recommended actions
SRE/QA: scenario tests for noisy signals, delayed metrics, and graceful rollback
Docs/DevRel: draft API docs and quickstart including example SDK wiring
Security: validate that experiment metadata and variant routes respect tenant isolation
rollback_conditions: Default: trigger rollback when the primary metric shows a relative degradation > 5% with posterior probability >= 95% vs baseline for two consecutive evaluation windows (configurable: threshold, confidence, consecutive_windows). For strict mode: any degradation >3% with probability >= 99% triggers immediate fallback. Also supports manual rollback from Console and emergency fallback to latest stable variant if routing health drops below SLO.
monitoring_plan: Expose per-variant: request rate, latency p95, key-quality metric (user-provided), posterior mean and 90/95 credible intervals, sample counts. Build alert rules: (1) sustained posterior-probability regression > 95% for 10 min, (2) sample skew (cohort imbalance) > 10%, (3) metric collection lag > 2 minutes. Add trace links to request samples and PRs. Dashboard template saved as 'CWEM - Default View'.
migration_notes: Migrate existing ad-hoc canaries: import route + baseline variant into an experiment object. Provide compatibility shim to run current manual ramps as a CWEM policy with min-exposure and growth=0 to preserve behavior. Communicate deprecation plan for legacy canary flags after 2 quarters.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: noisy metrics leading to oscillation. Mitigation: exposure controller includes hysteresis (min dwell time + growth smoothing) and requires consecutive negative windows before rollback. Risk: metric bias from differential sampling. Mitigation: recommend stratified sampling and include sample-weighted estimators. Risk: overreliance on default priors. Mitigation: Console warns when priors are default and shows sensitivity analysis.
